title: Plan a trip and hold the bookings, assembled
sub: Read-only lookups run in a loop; a booking call stops the loop and waits for a person to see the price and the cancellation terms.

nodes.l: Hold the checkpoint: price + terms, nothing spent
Person sees the price and the terms
Run only the approved call, or refuse
Booked, at the price a person approved

steps.d:
"Plan a trip from Wrenfield to Aldercliff for November 14 to
17, find somewhere to stay, and book the cheapest outbound
route."

steps.h: The model picks a read-only tool
Your code runs it and returns the result
steps.d:
R1 08:10-10:55 $89.00, refundable up to 24 hours before
R2 17:40-20:25 $64.00, non-refundable

steps.h: The model picks another read-only tool
Your code runs it and returns the result
steps.d:
S1 The Cormorant Inn $112.00/night, free cancellation to 48h
S2 Harrow Lane Hostel $43.00/night, non-refundable

steps.h: The model checks one more thing before deciding
Your code runs it and returns the result
The model decides what to book
steps.d:
-> book(kind="route", ref="R1")
(R2 is cheaper but arrives at 20:25, the evening the museum
would already be closed; the model picked R1 instead)

steps.h: Your code stops the loop and holds the checkpoint
steps.d:
R1: Wrenfield -> Aldercliff, 2026-11-14 08:10-10:55, $89.00
refundable up to 24 hours before departure
nothing is booked yet; the run returns here

steps.h: A person reviews the held booking and decides
steps.d:
sees: the route, $89.00, refundable up to 24 hours before
departure
decides: approve

steps.h: Your code checks the fingerprint and books it
steps.d:
the call still matches what was approved, so it runs:
"Booked R1: Wrenfield -> Aldercliff, 2026-11-14 08:10-10:55
for $89.00."
